spec_match.rationale: Field set and semantics match the SecurityInfo dictionary the feature references, driven from the same simulated data family as the sibling explorer and clearly labelled as simulation (Controlled Frame is IWA-only, so no regular page can call the real API).

interactive.rationale: The forbidden static code-card is fixed in place: the structure section is now an interactive field-by-field walkthrough — four scenario buttons swap the simulated connection, each field row is a real button revealing meaning/possible values/how-to-act in a polite live region. CDP-verified: scenario switch to Broken/self-signed and issuer field click produced the correct self-signed guidance; keyboard focus lands on field buttons.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Lede updated to describe the walkthrough.

edge_cases.rationale: Scenarios cover secure TLS1.3, TLS1.2 downgrade, self-signed and expired; per-field guidance branches on the actual scenario values (e.g. subject===issuer, validity past).

runtime_evidence.rationale: CDP desktop run exercised scenario + field buttons with correct aria-pressed state; mobile 360 scrollWidth 360; screenshots read on both classes; console clean except environmental fonts request.

telemetry_health.rationale: security-info-demo-field-walkthrough assert fires per field selection.

design_system.rationale: Variables only; scenario/field buttons override both background and color.

accessibility.rationale: Native buttons with aria-pressed, labelled group, aria-live=polite output panel.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: 360 and 1280 both verified clean with screenshots.

openQuestions.title: Unify the walkthrough data with the sibling explorer's presets
openQuestions.detail: The scenario objects duplicate ../security-info-explorer/'s PRESETS; extracting a shared JSON (fetched by both pages) would keep the two demos from drifting.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible disclosure walkthrough explaining fields keyboard
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use native buttons with reflected pressed state and route explanation text through a polite live region so selection is keyboard- and SR-operable.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Scenario and field rows are native <button>s with aria-pressed; the explanation panel is aria-live=polite; verified keyboard focus lands on field buttons via CDP.

summary: Interactivity fix for a forbidden static code-card, done additively on the same route: the SecurityInfo structure card became a clickable field-by-field walkthrough driven by the same simulated connection data as the sibling explorer, clearly labelled as simulation because Controlled Frame only exists inside Isolated Web Apps. Browser-verified with headless Chromium 141.0.7390.37 via raw CDP (trusted Input.dispatchMouseEvent clicks, console/network capture, 360x740 DPR3 mobile + 1280x800 desktop emulation, screenshots read) — chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud session. Chromium 141 predates Chrome 145, so 145-only success paths were validated on their honest fallback branches. The single failed fonts.googleapis.com stylesheet request is environmental and not counted against the page.
